title: AMPLIFAI: A Multiphase CT Dataset for Benchmarking Clinical Reasoning in LI-RADS Assessment of Liver Lesions
abstract: arXiv:2608.14778v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is the third leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, with early detection improving survival from <20\% to >70\%. The standardized LI-RADS criteria establish a biopsy-free, fully imaging-based framework that can serve as a foundation for automating HCC diagnosis with artificial intelligence (AI). However, the lack of large, publicly available datasets with high-quality labels has limited the development of AI models for LI-RADS characterization. We introduce the \textbf{AMPLIFAI} dataset, the first public dataset of multiphase abdominal CT scans annotated with LI-RADS categories and segmented for three major LI-RADS features: arterial phase hyperenhancement, washout, and enhancing capsule. Following the \emph{Datasheets for Datasets} format, this paper details the dataset's composition, curation process, and annotation pipeline to facilitate transparent, reproducible research.

translated_title: AMPLIFAI：用于LI-RADS肝脏病变评估中临床推理基准测试的多期CT数据集
translated_abstract: 肝细胞癌（HCC）是全球癌症相关死亡的第三大原因，早期检测可将生存率从<20%提高到>70%。标准化的LI-RADS标准建立了一个无需活检、完全基于影像的框架，可作为利用人工智能（AI）自动化HCC诊断的基础。然而，缺乏具有高质量标签的大规模公开数据集限制了用于LI-RADS分类的AI模型的发展。我们引入了**AMPLIFAI**数据集，这是首个公开的多期腹部CT扫描数据集，标注了LI-RADS类别，并针对三个主要LI-RADS特征进行了分割：动脉期高增强、廓清和增强包膜。遵循《数据集的数据表》格式，本文详细介绍了该数据集的组成、筛选过程和标注流程，以促进透明、可重复的研究。
tldr: 本文提出了AMPLIFAI，这是首个公开的、标注LI-RADS类别并分割三大特征的多期CT数据集，旨在推动AI在肝癌诊断中的临床推理基准测试。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AMPLIFAI, the first public multiphase CT dataset annotated with LI-RADS categories and segmented for three key features, aiming to benchmark clinical reasoning in AI-based HCC diagnosis.
